Carlos: Heads-up: midnight SLO recalibration & rollback drill tonight 00:30-01:15 UTC. Scope: us-west serving pools + routing control plane. Purpose: validate rollback play and observe tail behavior after config tweak.
Mei: What are we changing exactly?
Carlos: Temporarily bump P99 SLO for internal alerting from 220ms -> 300ms for the 45m window. Also enable new conservative routing policy that favors latency over cost for 10% traffic.
Priya: Test steps?
Carlos: Short plan:
- 00:30: post status note, enable synthetic traffic to us-west at 250 qps for 20m
- 00:35: flip routing policy for canary backends (10% traffic) to "latency-first"
- 00:55: trigger simulated spot reclaim by cordoning 3 nodes, watch autoscaler and fallback
- 01:05: initiate rollback drill: run `scripts/rollback/force_revert.sh us-west` and validate traffic returns
Allow 5-8m between steps to observe.
Jamal: Paste the cordon/drain commands?
Carlos: From controlplane: `kubectl cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`. To revert routing: `scripts/routing/revert_to_default.sh us-west`.
Mei: Rollback criteria?
Carlos: Abort and revert immediately if:
- sustained P99 > 420ms for >3m
- error rate jumps >0.8% absolute for >2m
- KV cache miss ratio >12% after 15m of warmup
If triggered, run rollback script and notify product and account ops.
Priya: Who's oncall?
Oncall Rotation: Priya primary, Jamal secondary, Mei tertiary. Night backup: Carlos.
SRE-Bot: Ticket RI-2026-909 created and calendar invites sent.
Jamal: I'll watch autoscaler events and fallback logs. Will post short metric snippets if anything drifts.
Mei: I'll handle the status page update 10m prior.
Carlos: Keep messages compact and include metric lines (e.g., p99: 312ms, err: 0.12%). Meet 01:20 UTC for 15m debrief.
SRE-Bot: Reminder: 10 minutes until window.
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll be on from 00:20->01:40 UTC.
Mei: :thumbsup:
Jamal: :white_check_mark:
